mt: MT is a radioactive transuranic element.
MT can also mean a unit of weight equivalent to 1000 kilograms.
MT can also mean a state in northwestern United States on the Canadian border.
MT means the same as meitnerium or element 109 or atomic number 109.
mt. ararat: Mt. Ararat is the mountain peak that Noah's ark landed on as the waters of the great flood receded.
Mt. Ararat means the same as Ararat or Mount Ararat.
mt. everest: Mt. Everest is a mountain in the central Himalayas on the border of Tibet and Nepal.
Mt. Everest means the same as Everest or Mount Everest.
mt. mckinley: Mt. McKinley is a mountain in south central Alaska.
Mt. McKinley means the same as McKinley or Mount McKinley or Denali.
mt. olympus: Mt. Olympus is a mountain peak in northeast Greece near the Aegean coast.
Mt. Olympus means the same as Olympus or Mount Olympus or Olimbos.
mt. rainier: Mt. Rainier is a mountain peak in central Washington.
Mt. Rainier means the same as Rainier or Mount Rainier or Mount Tacoma.
mt. rushmore: Mt. Rushmore is a mountain in the Black Hills of South Dakota.
Mt. Rushmore means the same as Rushmore or Mount Rushmore.
mt. st. helens: Mt. St. Helens is an active volcano in the Cascade Range in southwestern Washington.

mt. vesuvius: Mt. Vesuvius is a volcano in southwestern Italy on the Mediterranean coast.

mt etna: Mt Etna is an inactive volcano in Sicily.

mt orizaba: Mt Orizaba is an extinct volcano in southern Mexico between Mexico City and Veracruz.
